zh: 东西虽然贵，但是质量确实好。
old_en: Though the prices are high, the quality is indeed good.
new_en: Though the items are expensive, the quality is really good.

zh: 虽然价格有点高，不过东西还是不错的。
old_en: Although the prices are a bit high, the items are still pretty good.
new_en: Although the prices are a bit high, the items are still pretty good.

zh: 虽然已经很晚了，但他还是很兴奋。
old_en: Though it's very late, he's still very excited.
new_en: It's very late, but he's still very excited.

zh: 虽然很累，她还是坚持把工作做好了。
old_en: Although she was very tired, she still managed to finish her work.
new_en: She was very tired, but she still finished her work.

zh: 天气不好，不过我还是出去跑步了。
old_en: Though the weather was bad, I still went out for a run.
new_en: The weather was bad, but I still went out for a run.

zh: 虽然外面下雨了，但是我们还是出门看电影。
old_en: Although it was raining outside, we still went out to watch a movie.
new_en: It was raining, but we still went out to watch a movie.

zh: 他答应了，不过最后没来。
old_en: Though he agreed, he didn't show up in the end.
new_en: He agreed, but he didn't show up in the end.

zh: 虽然答应了，他却没有来。
old_en: Though he agreed, he didn't come.
new_en: He agreed, but he didn't come.

zh: 这个虽然便宜，可是不太好看。
old_en: Though it's cheap, it's not very attractive.
new_en: It's cheap, but not very attractive.

zh: 虽然价格便宜，不过款式有点过时。
old_en: Though it's cheap, the style is a bit outdated.
new_en: It's cheap, but the style is a bit outdated.

zh: 虽然今天很忙，我还是回了消息。
old_en: Though I was very busy today, I still replied to the message.
new_en: I was busy today, but I still replied to the message.

zh: 虽然会议结束得很晚，但他还是回了电话。
old_en: Though the meeting ended late, he still called back.
new_en: The meeting ended late, but he still called back.

zh: 路虽然远，不过沿途的风景很好。
old_en: Although the road is long, the scenery along the way is very nice.
new_en: The road is long, but the scenery is nice.

zh: 虽然今天下雨，不过我还是去了公园。
old_en: Although it rained today, I still went to the park.
new_en: It rained today, but I still went to the park.

zh: 虽然路程远，不过风景确实不错。
old_en: Though the journey was long, the scenery was indeed pleasant.
new_en: The journey was long, but the scenery was nice.

zh: 虽然这门课很难，但我觉得很值得。
old_en: Although this course is very difficult, I find it worthwhile.
new_en: The course is hard, but I think it's worth it.

zh: 他虽然很忙，不过还是抽空陪了我。
old_en: Although he was very busy, he still found time to accompany me.
new_en: Although he was very busy, he still made time to be with me.

zh: 虽然这药便宜，不过味道确实不好。
old_en: Though the medicine is cheap, its taste is really bad.
new_en: The medicine is cheap, but the taste isn't good.

zh: 虽然这本书便宜，不过内容有点少。
old_en: Though this book is cheap, it has somewhat fewer contents.
new_en: The book is cheap, but there's not much content.

zh: 这家店虽然有点远，不过我还是想去试试。
old_en: Though this store is a bit far, I still want to go and try it out.
new_en: The store is a bit far, but I still want to try it.
